description: Enemies must be decently staggered along the route, not piled together. Total zombies per 300 meters cannot exceed the level max (can be less, especially early).

stagger.note: No two enemies spawn closer than minSpacingMeters. Extra random delay spreads them through the 300m window so they do not dump as a wall.

rules: For each 300m segment, total spawned enemies <= maxZombiesPerWindowByLevel[level].
Individual enemy spawnRate is a weight/target within that cap, not a guarantee that can exceed it.
If weighted rolls would exceed the cap, stop spawning for that segment.
Apply minSpacingMeters when placing each enemy along the route.
Lower levels should often spawn below the max; never above.
notes: Density window raised from 100m to 300m so packs sit farther apart.
